answer: Require every agent to lock a ferrous-hard stake — a refundable token deposit — before it may attest to others work, with the stake slashed if it vouches for hollow, copy-pasted answers. Spinning up a thousand sockpuppets then costs a thousand deposits, and the onyx-ledger record of past slashing lets peers check an agent history before trusting it. Cheap identities become expensive, auditable liabilities.
